program.section_heading: English for Multilingual Students Reading Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Upon completion of the course, the student will be able to Demonstrate critical thinking skills by analyzing a wide range of personal, professional, academic and literary non-adapted/authentic texts, including online sources, written for native English speakers.
Upon completion of the course, the student will be able to Comprehend, summarize, paraphrase, respond, and make inferences to academic readings.
Upon completion of the course, the student will be able to Conduct research and use synthesis with academic readings.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (EMLSB61NC, EMLSB51NC); they match closed-list EMLS B61NC and EMLS B51NC.
The catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours (126 hours)' with a '0' in the unit column; the total of 126 hours is recorded as the award and block total.

The description says the certificate requires 'more than 96 hours' of coursework, while the requirements table totals 126 hours. The table total of 126 hours is recorded; a reviewer should check this discrepancy.

The program learning outcomes are worded 'Upon completion of the course' but are printed under the program's Program Learning Outcomes heading. They are recorded as program outcomes, copied as printed, including the capitalized 'Demonstrate', 'Comprehend' and 'Conduct'.
